Name: Sleep In - Dynamic Wake Times
Author: OrangeJuiceStain
Description:
[left]I always thought that the game is too forgiving with the player for staying up til 1:50AM and still waking up at 6AM to do it all over again. This mod was created to change that.[/left]
[center][/center]
[left]Now, if you stay up til 1:50AM, you won't be waking up until 10AM the next day. Guess you hit snooze a little too many times...[/left]
[left][/left]
[left][line]
[/left]
[left][/left]
[center][left]There are 3 presets to choose from and some toggleable settings.[/left]
[/center]
[list]
Easy[/list][spoiler][list]
Sleep time -- Wake up time[/list][list]
10:10PM  --  6:30AM[/list][list]
11:10PM  --  7:00AM[/list][list]
12:10AM  --  7:30AM[/list][list]
1:10AM    --  9:00AM[/list][/spoiler]
[list]
Normal (Default)[/list][spoiler][list]
Sleep time -- Wake up time[/list][list]
10:10PM  --  7:00AM[/list][list]
11:10PM  --  8:00AM[/list][list]
12:10AM  --  9:00AM[/list][list]
1:10AM   -- 10:00AM[/list][/spoiler]
[list]
Hard [/list][spoiler][list]
Sleep time -- Wake up time[/list][list]
10:10PM  --  7:30AM[/list][list]
11:10PM  --  9:00AM[/list][list]
12:10AM  -- 10:30AM[/list][list]
1:10AM  -- 12:00PM[/list][/spoiler]
[center][line]

[left][list]
[*][size=3][b]Ignore Festival Days: [/b]Prevents the player from 'sleeping in' because a festival placed the player back home exactly at 10PM or 12AM.[/size]
NOTE: You can still wake up late on the day of festivals if you go to bed too late the day before. Default: On[/*]
[*][b][b]Enable Mod[/b][/b]: Can enable or disable the mod at will. [b]Default: On, duh.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Debug Mode:[/b] Adds a lot of SMAPI log spam. Only enable this if told to. [b]Default: Off.[/b][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left]
[line]
[/left]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[left][b][size=4]Planned features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stamina debuff for staying up very late.[/*]
[*]Custom 'bed times' and 'wake up' times. If you go to bed at 9:10PM, you will wake up at 8PM the next day.[/*]
[*]Stamina Buffs for making your bedtime.[/*]
[*]And more if I think of anything.[/*]
[/list][/left]
[line]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, but recommended for changing Sleep In's settings.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip Sleep In - Dynamic Wake Times into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[b][size=4]Uninstallation[/size][/b]
Simply delete Sleep In from your mods folder and boom, get 4 hours a sleep every night for no penalty.
